Question 1 — shaded-fraction r2

12 points; 2.5 planned minutes; easy

Two of the five equal cells are shaded. Select all true statements about the shaded fraction \( p \).
  1. \( p = 0.4 \)

    Correct — option decimal

    Two divided by five is 0.4.
  2. \( p = \frac{3}{5} \)

    Incorrect — option unshaded

    This is the unshaded fraction.
  3. \( p + (1-p) = 1 \)

    Correct — option whole

    The two fractions cover the whole.
  4. \( p = 0 \)

    Incorrect — option zero

    Two cells are shaded.
  5. \( p > 1 \)

    Incorrect — option large

    A fraction of these cells cannot exceed one.

Question 2 — quadratic-function r2

24 points; 5 planned minutes; hard

For \( f(x) = x^2 \), select all true statements.
  1. \( f(0) = 0 \)

    Correct — option at-zero

    Zero squared is zero.
  2. \( f(3) = 9 \)

    Correct — option at-three

    Three squared is nine.
  3. \( f(-3) = -9 \)

    Incorrect — option negative

    A negative number squared is positive.
  4. \( f^{\prime}(x) = 2x \)

    Correct — option derivative

    Apply the power rule.
  5. The function is linear.

    Incorrect — option linear

    It is quadratic.
